graph_policy: Retain verified IG directed multigraph, remove old self loops then append exactly one per node; no PA-style reverse-edge overlay.
split_policy: Frozen IG contiguous labeled splits: train [0,136278514), valid [136278514,181704685), test [181704685,227130858); remaining nodes unlabeled.
scope: Per arm: 20 training warmup batches followed by three consecutive 30-batch timed training windows. No validation, test, accuracy, epoch extrapolation or steady-state claim.
author_decision: 2026-09-22: replace unfinished IG epoch with bounded training windows to exercise all model/system workflows.
reconstruction: Paper fanout10/5/5, hidden128, batch1024, group2 and GPU4GiB/CPU10%. Reuse existing verified IG graph/layout/cache selection. Adam and dropout from historical IG SAGE; same optimizer extended to GCN/GAT as untuned reconstruction. GAT 4x128 per head from historical implementation.
timing: CUDA synchronized wall time around each consecutive training window, including sampling, native feature fetch, copies, forward, loss, backward and optimizer. Counter snapshots, report writes, setup and warmup excluded. Cache/model/optimizer retained across windows; accounting region reset only at warmup/measurement boundary. Three windows share a process and are not independent repetitions.
